notes.title: Minor patch
notes.content:
Improvements done with guns and with rifle : shells now falls from weapon and weapon are now animated.
When holding any objects, hands are now attached to the body.
Improvement of the phones in the oval office.
If an extinguisher is shot, or stabbed, it now becomes pierced and some gaz will get out of the hole.
Minor bugs corrections.

notes.title: Weapons can now pierce and stab and minor corrections
notes.content:
Axe, swords, etc, can now pierce other objects, damaging them more.
Smooth movement staggering corrected, correction of the stuck problem
Two handed weapons are now attached to the body

notes.title: Smashing time major update
notes.content:
[h2]A new level is available[/h2] 
You can now destroy everything in a school classroom.
The level also has some special objects, like the chalk, some basket balls, a frizbee.
[h2]New weapons to unlock[/h2]
A rocket launcher, a laser gun, a whip, a nunchaku, a shotgun
[h2]Performances improvements and bug fixes[/h2]
A major performance improvement effort was made on this version, in order to make the game run faster.
Inscrease of performances when burning objects
Possibility to switch from high quality to low quality in the menu
Bug fixes related to sound, and sound effects volumes
Crash related bug fixes
[h2]Physics improvements [/h2]
Improvement of the handling of many objects (better handling of pens, pencils, chalks, better handling of sledgehammer, ...).
Bullets now bounces on metal
Better poop physics to glue things with poo
[h2]Original levels update[/h2]
Added switches for lights
Added toilets to the oval office

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content:
Now if you try to run with an object heavier than 20kgs in your hand, the object will be dropped
Improvement of the smooth turn smoothness and speed
Improvement of the smoothness of running movement
Objects broken pieces will stay longer before disappearing
Possibility to strafe using left joystick 
Hitting an object will reduce your speed when you run
Improvement of weapon handling

notes.title: Major bug correction
notes.content:
Major performance improvement when many objects are broken
Guns improvement : gun will now make different damage depending on the material hit, and will now spawn feathers when pillow is shot.
Poop can now be used as glue in order to stick objects on the wall
Physics bugs with the fire extinguisher correction
Now there is a gun hidden in every level (and some grenades in the museum)
Sound improvement for poop collision
Added sounds for frowing/shrinking effects
Grenade physics improvement
Throwing objects velocity improvement
Poop traces have been improved

notes.title: Minor bugs corrections Pillow/Yellow ball/Collisions/Physics
notes.content:
Pillow physics improved
Oval office : improvement of the collision boxes of the ruff
Infinite bounce ball : physics bug correction
Better balance for detecting when you hurt yourself
New sound effects when growing
Physics bugs corrections

notes.title: Minor bug correction
notes.content: Damage yourself with big objects + Small room reggression with hand tracking

notes.title: Minor bugs corrections
notes.content: Bow bug corrections and minor bug corrections

notes.title: One handed katana
notes.content: The katana can now be holded with only one hand, or with two hands

notes.title: WMR controllers
notes.content: Added key bindings for WMR controllers

notes.title: OuiOui when grown up
notes.content:
Now possible to pee or poo when your size is bigger or smaller
Bug correction with viking small axe
Poo can now merge on collision to make a bigger poo

notes.title: Valve index controller
notes.content: Valve index controller support quick fix

notes.title: Performance fixes + throw objects fix
notes.content:
New sounds for ceramics
Fixed weird handling of object in hand with baseball bats
Default movement type is now set to locomotion, it is now possible to walk or run
Added Haptic impulse on the hand when you hit hard something with a weapon in the hand
Minor performance improvements
Bug correction when throwing weapons : the spped of the object was not right when thrown
Music is now shuffled on start
Fixed major performance issue in the restaurant
